description: 让更早版本的资源包照常工作。Makes resource packs from older Minecraft versions work.

mods.name: ViaResourcePack
mods.description: Automatically converts resource packs to the running Minecraft version when they are loaded, for both local packs and server-sent packs.

releases.notes:
# ViaResourcePack 2.0.0-rc.1

转换器改为内置实现，只做向上迁移，客户端 1.14.4–26.3 可直接加载更早版本（含经典纹理包）的资源包。

## 主要变化
- **内置迁移引擎取代上游转换器**：不再随包携带第三方转换库，全程本地离线转换。
- **只向上、按完整 `pack_format` 判定**：旧包升到当前版本，新包保持原样，不再有降级路径。
- **源格式下探到经典纹理包时代**：`terrain.png` 时代的图集、方块状态与模型、GUI 与控制件、字体、声音事件、全景图、画作、地图、出生蛋、特殊物品姿态等按已知对应关系迁移。
- 客户端覆盖 1.14.4–26.3，单个 universal jar 通用，仍不需要 Fabric API。

## 界面与缓存
- 多个资源包改为**后台并行准备**，加载界面显示转换进度，不再逐个阻塞渲染线程。
- **已缓存且有效的包不再提示版本不兼容**，只有确实需要转换或无法转换时才出现原版警告。
- 中英文双语说明取代原版「为更旧版本打造」的提示文本。
- 临时文件、占位包与转换缓存移入 `resourcepacks/.viaresourcepack/`，缓存按 4 GiB 软预算自动清理。
- 重启后保留已启用的已转换包，无需重新勾选。

## 诊断
- 每个缓存条目生成 `warnings.txt`：未映射的图集格子、被移除的资源、无法保真的模型/着色器等，日志会给出路径。
- 详细迁移日志在默认 INFO 级别可见。

## 依赖
Gradle 9.9.2、Loom 1.19.4、Fabric Loader 0.20.1、MixinExtras 0.5.5、Sponge Mixin 0.17.5、Gson 2.15.0、SLF4J 2.0.20；测试栈 JUnit 6.1.3 / AssertJ 3.27.7。

## 兼容性
- 数据包与内置包（vanilla、Programmer Art、高对比度）不处理。
- 与加速资源包加载的模组（如 PackForge）组合尚未验证。
- 无法自动迁移的内容仍需手动调整；无报告不代表全部素材可用。

---

# ViaResourcePack 2.0.0-rc.1

The converter is now built in and upgrades only, so clients 1.14.4–26.3 can load packs made for earlier versions, including classic texture packs.

## Highlights
- **Built-in upgrade engine replaces the upstream converter** — no third-party conversion library is bundled, and everything runs offline.
- **Upgrades only, decided per full `pack_format`** — older packs are lifted to the running version, newer packs are left untouched, and there is no downgrade path.
- **Covers packs as far back as classic textures**: atlas-era `terrain.png`, blockstates and models, GUI atlases and widgets, fonts, sound events, panoramas, paintings, maps, spawn eggs, special item poses, and more migrate through known correspondences.
- Clients 1.14.4–26.3 with one universal jar; still no Fabric API required.

## UI and cache
- Packs are **prepared in the background in parallel** with progress on the loading screen, no longer blocking the render thread one pack at a time.
- **Valid cached packs no longer trigger the outdated-version warning**; the vanilla prompt appears only when a conversion is genuinely needed or impossible.
- Localized Chinese/English text replaces the vanilla “made for an older version” prompt.
- Temporary files, stubs, and converted packs live in `resourcepacks/.viaresourcepack/`, pruned against a 4 GiB soft budget.
- Converted packs stay enabled after a restart — no re-select needed.

## Diagnostics
- Each cache entry writes `warnings.txt` covering unmapped atlas cells, removed assets, and models/shaders that cannot be reproduced faithfully; the log points to it.
- Detailed migration logging is visible at the default INFO level.

## Dependencies
Gradle 9.9.2, Loom 1.19.4, Fabric Loader 0.20.1, MixinExtras 0.5.5, Sponge Mixin 0.17.5, Gson 2.15.0, SLF4J 2.0.20; test stack JUnit 6.1.3 / AssertJ 3.27.7.

## Compatibility
- Data packs and built-in packs (vanilla, Programmer Art, High Contrast) are not processed.
- Combinations with pack-loading accelerators such as PackForge are unverified.
- Assets without a known equivalent still need manual work; the absence of a report does not guarantee every asset works.
